title: Harrison Bay Resort and RV Park

services.name: Cabins
services.desc: Harrison Bay resort features three waterfront, fully-furnished cabins available for rent. All our cabins are furnished including major appliances and a microwave, coffee maker, kettle, toaster; dishes and cookware. Pillows, bedding, towels, dish soap, hand soap and toilet paper are supplied. A few household cleaners are supplied in the bathroom cabinet for your use. Guests also have use of our boat launch and main dock. Free Wireless Internet is available! Cozy two bedroom, with combined living/dining room (including love seat and chair and kitchen table with four chairs). Rock area in back of cabin with water front view. Larger two bedroom, with spacious kitchen area. Dining room large

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Harrison Bay Resort is a peaceful getaway located on Lougheed Highway (Hwy 7) between Mission and Harrison Hot Springs, nestled along the calming waters of Harrison Bay in Lake Errock, BC.
